messages:
incident-bot: 🚨 INCIDENT: Prod EU cluster - Post-deploy pod flapping detected (deploy v3.4.1). Paging oncall-sre. See initial alerts: high restart counts, 502 responses from router. Runbook: <https://redwood.internal/runbooks/k8s-deploy-failure>.

alex.sre: acked, on it. getting kube access. what was in the roll? mira.platform pushed the v3.4.1 canary ~10m ago right?

mira.platform: yup, canary at 01:19 UTC, promoted to 50% at 01:35, full at 01:47. change was HPA tweak + new liveness probe timeout and a small memory request adjust for api-worker.

devraj: seeing a lot of CrashLoopBackOff on api-worker-*. logs show OOMKilled then restart loop. also some pods stuck in Pending on nodes with no allocatable memory.

alex.sre: paste logs from pod api-worker-7f8b9:
```
2026-03-15T01:58:13Z ERROR out-of-memory
Killed process 2345 (node) total-vm:1200000kB, anon-rss:980000kB
Restarting container
```

alex.sre: looks like memory request in the manifest got lowered from 1Gi to 128Mi by mistake (typo). sending kubectl patch to pause rollout now.

mira.platform: confirmed — we accidentally used "128M" instead of "128Mi" in one manifest and then a global patch removed the 1Gi default. Ugh.

deploy-bot: Received command: `kubectl rollout pause deployment/api-worker -n prod-eu` by alex.sre. Rollout paused (revision 42).

alex.sre: immediate mitigation: 1) pause rollout (done), 2) flip feature-flag for new-worker-feature to false to reduce traffic to api-worker, 3) scale down new replicas to buy time, 4) rollback to previous revision with correct resources.

mira.platform: flipping flag now (ld: toggle).

elaine-support: heads-up, ops: support seeing ~8% of EU requests 502 for last 10m, mostly from enterprise accounts in eu-west-1. escalating to account owners.

oncall-pager: @here I'm stepping in as primary. I'll run the rollback once the flag is confirmed off.

mira.platform: feature flag off ✅ (ld change id: ff-9921). traffic to the new handler dropped ~70% per edge metrics.

alex.sre: scaling api-worker down to 1 replica for safety: `kubectl scale deploy/api-worker --replicas=1 -n prod-eu`

k8s-bot: Action: `scale` accepted. api-worker scaled from 12 -> 1 (graceful).

devraj: some pods didn't terminate cleanly -> stuck Terminating for >5m because of PVCs with local storage and no pod disruption budget configured. trying `kubectl delete pod --force --grace-period=0` on the stuck ones.

alex.sre: manual delete succeeded for 3 stuck pods. note: PDBs for api-worker are missing, adding a temporary relaxed PDB to allow safe eviction.

mira.platform: preparing rollback manifest to revision 41 (pre-change). will `kubectl rollout undo deployment/api-worker --to-revision=41 -n prod-eu` after approval.

deploy-bot: Rollout history shows revision 42 (current), rev 41 (stable).

alex.sre: approve rollback. also adding a quick fix patch to bump requests back to 1Gi in the manifest repo — we'll pin it outside the pipeline to avoid re-triggering rollout until verified.

mira.platform: applied manual patch in gitops: set resources.requests.memory=1Gi for api-worker. withholding full CI promotion.

deploy-bot: Executing: `kubectl rollout undo deployment/api-worker --to-revision=41 -n prod-eu` as mira.platform.

k8s-bot: Rollout undo accepted. new rollout started. watch: `kubectl rollout status deployment/api-worker -n prod-eu`.

alex.sre: monitoring logs and readiness. post-undo new pods coming up healthy. restart counts stabilizing.

elaine-support: customer impact reduced; 502 rate down to 1.2% in EU. sending update to affected customers now.

devraj: noticed HPA was configured with targetCPU 5 (percent?) which is weird; also minReplicas=0 which allowed scale-to-zero during the promotion window and aggravated cold-starts. opening a follow-up ticket to tighten HPA and set appropriate minReplicas.

mira.platform: yes the HPA change was intended to decrease burst overhead but the units were mis-specified (target average utilization 5 instead of 50). pushing a postmortem item.

alex.sre: post-rollback status: all api-worker pods stable, no CrashLoopBackOff, memory usage normal. router errors down to baseline. marking incident as mitigated.

incident-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-0315-1721. Severity: Sev2 -> degraded customer experience. Timeline: 01:47 deploy promoted -> 01:58 alerts -> 02:03 rollback started -> 02:45 mitigated.

oncall-pager: I'll hand off to @mira.platform at 06:00 UTC for follow-up and postmortem. leaving notes in the incident document.

mira.platform: Acked. I'll collect diffs, CI traces, and open a postmortem ticket. suggested next steps: 1) revert any gitops auto-promotions until manifest lint catches unit typos, 2) add HPA unit validation to e2e, 3) require non-zero minReplicas for critical workers, 4) add basic PDB for api-worker.

elaine-support: sent customer communication: "We've reverted a deployment and mitigated the issue; a full postmortem will follow."

alex.sre: saved useful commands in incident doc (snippet):
```
kubectl get pods -n prod-eu -o wide | grep api-worker
kubectl describe pod api-worker-7f8b9 -n prod-eu
kubectl rollout undo deployment/api-worker --to-revision=41 -n prod-eu
kubectl patch deploy api-worker -p '{"spec":{"template":{"spec":{"containers":[{"name":"api-worker","resources":{"requests":{"memory":"1Gi"}}}]}}}}' -n prod-eu
```

incident-bot: Closing active page. Please file postmortem and tag with INC-2026-0315-1721. 

mira.platform: filing postmortem now, will ping the group once ready.

oncall-pager: handing off. leaving monitoring alerts suppressed for 1h to avoid noise.

elaine-support: thanks team :clap:

alex.sre: good job everyone. lessons learned logged.
